profile: mini-batch gradient descent: an extension of standard gradient descent designed to accelerate minimization of cost functions consisting of a sum of P terms. Example settings include a learning rate of α = 10−2, batch size 200, and 20 steps/epochs applied to a multi-class Softmax cost. Empirically, a mini-batch run drastically accelerates minimization in terms of both the cost function and the number of misclassifications.
